verdict.rationale: Sardine's own marketing describes 'audit-ready agents' for automated KYC/AML alert reviews (sardine-docs-28) and a Case Management workspace where analysts review alerts and resolve cases (sardine-docs-26). AI agents also route higher-risk matches to analysts (sardine-docs-18), which covers both automated and human decision paths. This is only a glancing claim, though: nothing documents an actual audit log, timestamps, or a way for a compliance officer to retrieve or export the trail. Missing for 10: a documented timestamped audit log of case decisions, coverage of human analyst actions in that log, a retrieval/export mechanism (UI or API), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
